name: void
role: the night itself: screen black, bottom of the water gradient (#060d22 -> #050b1c -> #03070f -> #02040a), the opaque near-black body behind every creature, the glass-tube logo and the crystal slabs (#04060e), HUD ground

name: abyss
role: deep-water reference tone: the top stop of the water gradient is abyss pushed ~78 % toward void (#060d22), so the frame reads near-black; the undarkened #0b1a33 only appears as its swatch on the cast sheet's palette strip

name: cyan
role: Pop / P2 / 2UP, the POP lettering and bubble-O, bubble thin-film (cyan end) and the 'empty' bubble tint, surface god-rays (additive 1-2 %), Bonefin's cold eye flame, P2's EXTEND letters, the pearl at the foot of the tower; pulled toward azure (#3fb0e6) for the platform crystal edges so structure never competes with the twins

name: magenta
role: Fizz / P1 / 1UP, the FIZZ lettering (toward violet at the bottom of each tube), sea-fan tufts on platform tops, P1's EXTEND letters and life pearls, bubble film (magenta band), Kraken tentacle tips; kept ~32 deg of hue away from the angry red

name: lime
role: Springle (the only green thing on screen), spring coil energy

name: amber
role: Nibbler, HI SCORE, thunder bubble, Glimmer's lantern, Kraken's crown and eyes, trap warning stage 1 (bubble rim + film), score popups, the lit windows of the title tower

name: violet
role: Jellop, Pop's gill plumes (violet + 20 % cyan), thin-film midtone in every bubble, lower half of the FIZZ tubes, Kraken royal purple = violet + 42 % magenta (#bb4fd9), bottom abyss tint; the giant background jellyfish are deliberately NOT violet (cobalt/teal, cobalt/violet, violet/magenta mixes) so they never merge with Jellop

name: white-hot
role: the hot core line of every neon stroke, the outer wall edge of the logo tubes, eyes and their highlights, specular streaks on bubbles/tubes/slabs, Bonefin's bones; the brightest few percent of any frame: hot strokes, highlights, never a large fill

name: ember
role: Crabbit and the fire bubble, the sushi topping (mixed with magenta); the ANGRY state pushes any hostile to crimson-red #ff2a2a (derived) with steam, slanted brows and a pulsing red heat halo

name: cobalt
role: Glimmer the anglerfish, water bubble, lower half of the POP tubes, translucent platform body tint (#2a72b8), the giant left/right background jellyfish (mixed with cyan / violet), far fog
